ART CLUB
Bring an old shirt to wear when you paint. There are paints and brushes in the room.

parts.title: Three homes
parts.instructions: Read about the homes. Choose the right home for each question.
parts.passage:
A. Rosa’s home
Our house is near the train station. It has four bedrooms and a small yard. On summer evenings my family often eats outside.

B. Tom’s home
I have a one-bedroom apartment on the sixth floor. I can see the park from the living room. My favorite room is the living room.

C. Luz’s home
We live in a house next to a supermarket. There are two bedrooms. My school is near our house. It takes me ten minutes to walk there.

questions.prompt: Who can see the park without leaving their apartment?
questions.explanation: Tom sees the park from his living room.

questions.prompt: Who lives next door to a place where people buy food?
questions.explanation: Luz’s house is next to a supermarket.

questions.prompt: Whose family often has a meal outside at the end of a summer day?
questions.explanation: Rosa’s family often eats outside in summer.

questions.prompt: Who has fewer bedrooms than the other two people?
questions.explanation: Tom has a one-bedroom apartment.

parts.title: A party message
parts.instructions: Choose one word for each numbered gap.
parts.passage:
Hi Luis,
My sister’s party is (1) ____ Friday. You can come (2) ____ train. The party is in a room next (3) ____ the café. There (4) ____ four big tables in the room. See you at four!
María

questions.explanation: Use on with a day of the week.
Use by before a means of transport, such as by train.
The preposition phrase is next to.
Use there are for more than one table.

parts.title: Four short conversations
parts.instructions: Read the questions. Listen twice and choose one answer for each question.
parts.transcript:
Narrator: Question one.
Ben: Is the class picnic in the park this week?
Maya: No, it's going to rain. We're having lunch in the school gym.
Ben: The gym? Okay, thanks.

Narrator: Question two.
Ben: Do you have these shoes in black?
Maya: Only in brown. The black ones come in next week.
Ben: I'll take the brown ones today.

Narrator: Question three.
Maya: I can't find my bag. Is it in the living room?
Ben: No, I put it under your bed, in your bedroom.
Maya: Thanks.

Narrator: Question four.
Maya: What can you do at the school fair? Can you make cakes?
Ben: I can't make cakes, but I can take photos.
Maya: Great, bring your camera.

questions.prompt: Where is the class picnic now?
questions.explanation: The class will eat in the school gym because of rain.

questions.prompt: Which shoes does the customer buy?
questions.explanation: He takes the brown pair today.
The boy put it under the bed.

questions.prompt: What can the boy do at the fair?
questions.explanation: He can take photos and will bring his camera.

parts.title: A market visit
parts.instructions: Listen twice. Write one word or a number in each gap.
parts.transcript: Ben: Hi, this is Dan. Let's visit the market on Saturday. Meet me at the train station at nine. We can take bus number eight from there. Bring a bag for your food. You don't need to bring lunch. We can buy sandwiches at the market. See you at the station.

questions.explanation: Dan says the visit is on Saturday.
They meet at nine.
They will take bus eight.
Dan asks for a bag for food.
